name: columbia-of-timecards
description: Field timecards against crew assignments, job status and the cost codes in each job budget: hours on a job the worker was not assigned to that day, on a closed job, or on a cost code the job has no budget for; days longer than your limit; weekend work; and entries made twice. Worker names are masked in what the AI model sees. Drafts recode requests. Never edits a timecard or runs payroll.
